title: Independent verification: all orthogonal chart phase defects and equal fibers
body:
For PR1255's normalized complex residual, the possible defects of an orthogonal binary chart rebase are exactly the vectors of weight divisible by four. The explicit involution `T_d = I + d d^t` realizes each defect and factors every rebase as `S = T_d H`, where `H` preserves the exact residual. Each defect fiber has the same size. This is a scoped proof and independent verification, with no physical phase-repair or new kappa claim.

The package independently derives the orthogonal-group order by a first-column transversal, reconstructs PR1255's entire dimensions 1–6 defect census without importing its executable code, and gives exact counts at selected widths 7, 8 and 9: 40,320, 2,580,480 and 348,364,800 exact preservers. A short Gaussian-sum necessity argument and explicit transvection sufficiency argument apply in every dimension. Classical group and quadratic-refinement facts carry no literature-wide priority claim.

All changes are in `research/orthogonal-phase-defect-spectrum/`. Start with its README proof and `CERTIFICATE.json`. Base and final refreshed main: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Exact predecessor PR1255: `add1e2673ef000c097ec0fd70058e644af048d6b`; its receipt and notice are retained unchanged. `SOURCES.json` pins the inherited C-gate source and selected provenance.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/orthogonal-phase-defect-spectrum
```

Expected: `PASS_ORTHOGONAL_PHASE_DEFECT_SPECTRUM matrices=23817 literal_coefficients=187868 controls=9 no_new_kappa`, seven passing test groups, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Validation passed with CPython 3.12.13 and 3.14.7, including optimized and relocated checks. Coverage includes all 23,817 matrices in dimensions 1–6; all 271 constructive defects in dimensions 1–9; 187,868 exact literal convolution coefficients across both signs; 1,022 direct Gaussian sums; the twisted cocycle; nine semantic controls; and five real on-disk corruptions. A separate full binary-matrix enumeration through dimension four agrees with the transversal. Repository research tests (20, one existing skip), five selected-result tests, selected integrity and source-pin checks pass.

The all-dimension theorem is a written proof, not a formal-kernel proof; larger group sizes follow from it rather than exhaustive matrix enumeration. The selected controller still binds literal charts/routes. Local normalized endpoints, physical/compiler admission, whole-supplier costs, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain inherited. No selected cold replay, human review or hosted CI success is claimed; no selected frontier or upstream file changes.

OS assignment seed 75, independent verification. The local claim records three candidates and the explicitly changed repository-card scope. Final overlap refresh covered 792 open PR bodies and 21 current Discussion threads, with no matching defect-spectrum/factorization claim. This extends PR1255 rather than repeating its emitted-chart audit; PR1282/1291 signed norms and PR1294 dirty block identities are distinct.

Credit Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with his disclosed OpenAI Codex assistance, for PR1255's phase criterion, convolution contract and source-bound census; Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan, Josie Elliston, Douglas Colkitt and the inherited Clifford/normalization lineage. Prepared by Philipp / mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and prose. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
